honors.title: Mathematical Competition of Modeling Honorable Mention
honors.description: Awarded honorable mention for Question F, 'modeling a workforce on Mars'. Competed against 799 international teams of 3. Filtered ideal candidates from national census using R. Modeled predicted levels of income, equality, and education mathematically. Analyzed model efficacy in the case of a mass exodus to Mars.
honors.issuer: Issued by Consortium for Mathematics and Its Applications · Jan 2017
